fusions.name: Bounding Shot
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Startling Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 4 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage and knocking the target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Flight Instinct
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 5 seconds, with +12% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Flinch Aside
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
